1 The mission consisted of Douglas Pearce (Practice Manager, EAWF1); Rafael Pardo (Senior Financial Sector Specialist and
TTL); Keren Charles (Senior DRM Specialist, co-TTL, outgoing); Isabelle Kane (Senior DRM Specialist and co-TTL, incoming);
Anupa A. Pant (Private Sector Specialist and co-TTL); Jose Miguel Villascusa Cerezo (Tourism Consultant); Brahim Hamed
(Senior Procurement Specialist); Scott Ferguson (Senior Flood Risk Management Consultant); and Fabio Cian (DRM
Consultant). Nancy Njie (Environmental Consultant) and Momodou Sey (Consultant) joined from The Gambia. Frederic
Meunier (Economist); Kaliza Karuretwa (Senior Private Sector Specialist) and Aji Oumie Jallow (Administrative Assistant)
joined for the B-READY workshops. Louise Twining-Ward (Senior Private Sector Specialist and Tourism Technical Lead) joined
a week after to host an ecotourism regional workshop and provide tourism implementation support to the PIU .
